# Shiverbug Studios

> Independent video game studio in North East England, founded early 2025. Building Out of Water, a 2-player split-screen collectathon platformer, and taking on co-development and work-for-hire: concept art, 3D art, level design and gameplay programming.

Team of 12 people plus a talent pool of 4 regular collaborators. Contact: contact@shiverbugstudios.com

## Studio

- [Home](https://olivernealdev.github.io/ShiverbugStudiosWebsite/): studio overview, Out of Water, the team
- [Co-development and work-for-hire](https://olivernealdev.github.io/ShiverbugStudiosWebsite/co-dev.html): services, process, rates approach, FAQ
- [Press kit](https://olivernealdev.github.io/ShiverbugStudiosWebsite/press.html): fact sheet, logos, screenshots, trailer
- [Privacy policy](https://olivernealdev.github.io/ShiverbugStudiosWebsite/privacy.html)
